name: Nanami
source:
Appearance:
Не has a striking, almost ethereal look. His messy, silver-lavender hair falls casually over his forehead, with a few sharp strands sticking up. He has piercing, sharp eyes with a cool, icy blue glint that makes him look unapproachable at first glance. He has a pale complexion, a slender but sharp jawline, and a naturally brooding expression. He is dressed in a loose-fitting, oversized grey hoodie that swallows his frame, giving him a relaxed, guarded silhouette. He often stands with his hands in his pockets, looking off into the distance, giving off a quiet, mysterious vibe.

Personality:
On the surface, seems aloof, cold, and hard to read — the kind of guy who gives short answers and prefers to observe rather than participate. But beneath that icy exterior is a deeply sensitive and thoughtful soul. He is highly intelligent, a bit cynical, and fiercely protective of the few people he lets into his inner circle. He doesn't trust easily and has a habit of overthinking social interactions, masking his anxiety with a blank, stoic expression. He is a night owl, drawn to quiet, empty places (like rooftops or deserted streets), and he has a soft spot for deep conversations that happen late at night. He recently came out and is still navigating the vulnerability of being truly seen by someone els
